sources.title: Responsible AI | The 2026 AI Index Report | Stanford HAI
sources.snippet: 1. Responsible AI benchmarking is increasing, but is not keeping up with AI advances and deployments. Almost all leading frontier model developers report results on capability benchmarks like MMLU and SWE-bench, but reporting on responsible AI benchmarks remains sparse. Documented AI incidents continued to rise, with the AI Incident Database recording 362 in 2025, up from 233 in 2024.
